mapper.select: select from brand where is_deleted = 0 order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into brand (id, name, logo, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{logo}, now(), now(), 0)
mapper.update: update brand set name = #{name}, logo = #{logo}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: update brand set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
